label: VILLAGE JOBS / FROM A LOCAL TASK TO A CONVERSATION

English first. Korean available.

label: 01 / TEXT FIRST. VOICE OPTIONAL.
cues: Post a task without signing in.
Text first. Voice is optional.

label: 02 / REAL META MUSE SPARK RESPONSE
cues: Meta Muse Spark extracts the task conditions.
Place, time, pay and people needed.

label: 03 / THE FARMER STAYS IN CONTROL
cues: The farmer stays in control.
Edit the pay and description, then review.

label: 04 / REVIEW, THEN PUBLISH
cues: Review, then publish.
Edit or close it from the same browser.

label: 05 / DISCOVER LOCAL WORK
cues: Search by town and open the details.
See the place, time and pay before signing in.

label: 06 / LOCAL TEST AUTHENTICATION
cues:
Verify before applying.
Local test code only; no email sent.

label: 07 / CONTACT SHARING REQUIRES CONSENT
cues: Add a name, note and contact.
Explicit consent is required to share it.

label: 08 / START A DIRECT CONVERSATION
cues: The farmer sees the shared contact in My jobs.
They arrange the work and payment directly.

label: 09 / WITHDRAWAL HIDES THE CONTACT
cues: Withdrawal hides the shared contact.
Already-seen information cannot be taken back.

label: 10 / HONEST MVP BOUNDARIES
cues: Memory-only data resets on server restart.

Real-user validation and retention impact
remain unproven.
